name: Discovery (STS-92)
about: Discovery (STS-92) (2000-062A), a crewed vehicle (STS), launched 2000 Oct 11. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2000 Oct 13), held fixed
docked to A06140; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
